question: In which specific locations may the goddess be placed on the pedestal?
premises: The first part of the pedestal on the ground is a possible locus.
The pedestal base is another possible locus.
The goddess is the object to be placed.
inference: Therefore one should place the goddess on the first part of the pedestal on the ground or on the pedestal base.
plain_english: One should place the goddess on the first part of the pedestal on the ground, or else on the pedestal base.
